requirements: worker/configuration/asa/AsaConfigProcessor: process(raw) -> Processed(canonicalHash, withheldLineCount, sanitizedText, index, settingCount) like FortiGateConfigProcessor. Skip volatile lines (': Saved', ': Written by', ': Serial Number', ': Hardware', 'Cryptochecksum', blank ':' lines) from the hash. Top-level line = a new block; lines starting with one space belong to the current block. Section = the block's kind in title case by its leading keyword(s) (Interface, Object network, Object-group, Access-list, Route, Nat, Crypto map, Tunnel-group, Group-policy, Aaa-server, Logging, Snmp-server, Ntp, Ssh, Http, Failover, Policy-map, Class-map, ...); setting = block name + sub-line (or the whole top-level line for flat commands such as access-list/route). Index context = 'single'.

ConfigurationVendor CISCO_ASA, ConfigurationRequest.ciscoAsa(target, credRef, trustRuleRef), ConfigurationCapabilityExecutor case -> collectCiscoAsa reusing the ASA interactive session code path (factor a small shared helper from CiscoAsaExecutor if needed, without changing its backup behaviour); stores the raw artefact with vendor 'cisco_asa' and returns ConfigurationRunData like the FortiGate path

ConfigurationCapabilityIds.ASA_CONFIGURATION_COLLECT = 'asa_configuration_collect'; register it wherever FGT_CONFIGURATION_COLLECT is registered (WorkerClaimLoop eligible list and request build, ConfigurationCollectService vendor mapping, DeviceCompositionConfiguration)
